title: Prawn Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy stir fry with prawns and frozen vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: frozen
ingredients.amount: 1 cup mixed vegetables (e.g., peas, carrots, corn)

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the thawed mixed vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Add the prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Stir in the soy sauce and oyster sauce (if using).
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped green onions (if desired).
